_what: The DESIGN half of the Simple Design System extraction: for each imported component set, its variant axes and values, its component PROPERTY definitions, and its description. Nothing else - no colour, length, font, duration or easing curve, because those are realisations and a register may not hold one (VDS S-2(4)).
_why: SDS is the only honest test subject available for the importer: a real Figma library that is reachable, whose real code is published at github.com/figma/sds, and NEITHER SIDE IS MINE. An extractor tested only against its own output cannot be surprised.
_how: importComponentSetByKeyAsync against keys returned by search_design_system, on 2026-07-31. The negative control ran FIRST: an impossible all-zeros key was refused with the byte-identical message Uber Base gives, so the seven passes are not an API returning something for anything.
_finding: FIGMA MODELS STATE AS A VARIANT AXIS, and it is not a quirk of my blocks. FIVE of these seven sets carry a State axis (Default/Hover/Disabled/Active/Range), and Figma own reference system does it because a static drawing cannot hold a runtime value. That is INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION of the different_axis finding in figma-variants.json, where eleven of my control primitives varied STATE in Figma and COMPOSITION in code. The mismatch is a property of the medium, and Figma themselves hit it.
_second_finding: A VARIANT AXIS IS NOT THE WHOLE CONTRACT, and this is the bigger gap. These sets carry component PROPERTIES as well as axes: TEXT (a label), BOOLEAN (has-icon-start), INSTANCE_SWAP (which icon) and SLOT (arbitrary content). Those are PROPS, not axes. A register that recorded only the axes would miss Label, Has Icon Start and the slot entirely - which is most of what a developer actually implements. site-factory records one variant prop and one content object; SDS distinguishes seven properties on Button alone. INSTANCE_SWAP and SLOT are the two with no counterpart in the site-factory contract at all.

_notHarvested: 7 of the 400+ components SDS advertises. This is a SLICE and says nothing about the rest: the button family was chosen because search_design_system surfaced it for the query "button", not because it is representative. The CODE half, from github.com/figma/sds, is not yet read - and comparing the two is the whole point of choosing this subject.
_code_half: Read independently and compared in vendor/sds-code-contract.json. Five findings, and the sharpest is that the SAME Figma shape (BOOLEAN + INSTANCE_SWAP) becomes positional CHILDREN on Button and an `icon` ReactNode PROP on NavigationButton - so the code side of a binding is not derivable from the Figma side.
